summary: Full backend + frontend testing after WhatsApp/beats refactor. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests PASS across two files (test_bigsmedia_api.py: 18 tests for services/portfolio/quotes/appointments/auth/admin flows; test_beats.py: 7 new tests for /api/beats public + /api/admin/beats CRUD, 401 without token, create+soft-delete+404). Frontend (mobile 390x844): Home shows BIG S MEDIA hero + 3 action cards (Réserver->Studio, Catalogue->Beats, Paiement->/paiement modal) + all 6 contact rows (Téléphone, E-mail, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram); admin key icon opens /admin/login. Beats tab lists exactly 3 seeded instrumentales; 'Commander' builds correct wa.me/22796558193 link with pre-filled 'Bonjour Big S, je suis intéressé par l'instrumentale: Afro Zouk Love Vol. 1' (verified by intercepting window.open). Studio: 4 service options render, empty-name send blocks WhatsApp open and shows validation toast, filled name builds correct WA reservation link containing name + selected service (Mixage & Mastering). Paiement screen shows reception number +227 96 55 81 93, MyNita/Amanata selector works, 'Confirmer' builds wa.me link with chosen method, close button returns. Admin login with admin@bigsmedia.com / BigS2026!Admin succeeds; 2 tabs (Réalisations, Instrumentales) visible with stat cards; created + deleted a beat and a project through UI, both round-trip to backend. No red screens. Only pre-existing RN-web console warnings (useNativeDriver JS fallback, props.pointerEvents deprecation). Success: backend 100%, frontend 100%.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported...' — harmless JS fallback on web. Reference: transient library-level warning, no user impact.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Originates from a dependency; monitor only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: New beats endpoints correctly mirror portfolio pattern — seeded on startup only when count==0, soft-delete via deleted_at, _id excluded from responses.
server.py: GET /api/beats and admin/beats use sort('created_at', 1) so seeded beats keep insertion order — good for consistent catalog display.
contact.ts: openWhatsApp encodes message via encodeURIComponent and targets wa.me/22796558193 — matches Flutter source requirement.

beats.tsx / studio.tsx / paiement.tsx: All call openWhatsApp (Linking.openURL) with pre-filled messages; testIDs are present on every actionable element (order-beat-<id>, studio-send-button, studio-service-<opt>, studio-payment-button, confirm-payment-button, close-payment-button, payment-method-<m>).
admin/index.tsx: 2-tab manager (projects/beats) uses React Query with proper invalidation of both admin and public queries after mutations — UI stays in sync.
seed_data_creation: TEST-prefixed beat + project created via UI/API during testing and cleaned up afterward via admin DELETE endpoints. Backend seed of 3 beats + 4 projects verified present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend covered by /app/backend/tests/test_bigsmedia_api.py + test_beats.py (25 tests, parallel-safe, ~4s). WhatsApp/tel/mailto opens must be validated by intercepting window.open on web (Linking.openURL uses window.open); route interception does NOT catch these external schemes on web.
